description: This Java class 'UtilURL' provides utility methods for working with URLs, resource files, and file paths within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions to load resources, convert filenames and URLs into URL objects, and retrieve environment-specific paths.

classes.name: UtilURL
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for URL and resource handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: fromClass
methods.description: Creates a URL for a properties resource related to a given class.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Retrieves a URL for a resource by name, either with or without a ClassLoader.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Converts a filename path to a URL if the file exists.

methods.name: fromUrlString
methods.description: Creates a URL object from a string, if valid.

methods.name: fromOfbizHomePath
methods.description: Generates a URL based on the OFBIZ_HOME environment property combined with a filename.

methods.name: getOfbizHomeRelativeLocation
methods.description: Returns the relative path of a URL with respect to the OFBIZ_HOME directory.
